{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check number of patients with biomarker_baseline = -999
missing_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
total_missing = len(missing_baseline)
responded_missing = missing_baseline['responded'].sum()
response_rate_missing = responded_missing / total_missing if total_missing > 0 else 0

# Check distribution of missing data across sites
missing_by_site = missing_baseline['site'].value_counts()

# Compute response rate for each site, including all deduplicated patients (including those with -999)
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print all results
print(f'Number of patients with biomarker_baseline = -999: {total_missing}')
print(f'Response rate among those with missing baseline: {response_rate_missing:.4f}')
print(f'Missing data by site:
{missing_by_site}')
print(f'Response rates by site (including missing baseline patients):\n{response_rate_by_site}')"}
